enabled.description: All calls will be sent to voicemail.

sendAllCalls.description: Settings for sending all calls to voicemail.

enabled.description: Calls will be sent to voicemail when busy.

greeting.description:
`DEFAULT` indicates the default greeting will be played. `CUSTOM` indicates a custom `.wav` file will be played.
 * `DEFAULT` - The default greeting will be played.
 * `CUSTOM` - Designates that a custom `.wav` file will be played.

greetingUploaded.description: A custom greeting has been uploaded.

sendBusyCalls.description: Settings for sending calls to voicemail when the line is busy.

enabled.description: Enables and disables sending unanswered calls to voicemail.

greeting.description:
`DEFAULT` indicates the default greeting will be played. `CUSTOM` indicates a custom `.wav` file will be played.
 * `DEFAULT` - The default greeting will be played.
 * `CUSTOM` - Designates that a custom `.wav` file will be played.

greetingUploaded.description: A custom greeting has been uploaded

numberOfRings.description: Number of rings before unanswered call will be sent to voicemail.

systemMaxNumberOfRings.description: System-wide maximum number of rings allowed for `numberOfRings` setting.

enabled.description: Send of unanswered calls to voicemail is enabled or disabled.

destination.description: Email address to which the notification will be sent. For text messages, use an email to text message gateway like `2025551212@txt.example.net`.

notifications.description: Settings for notifications when there are any new voicemails.

enabled.description: Enabled or disabled state of giving caller option to transfer to destination when pressing zero (0).

destination.description: Number voicemail caller will be transferred to when they press zero (0).

transferToNumber.description: Settings for voicemail caller to transfer to a different number by pressing zero (0).

enabled.description: When `true` copy of new voicemail message audio will be sent to the designated email.

emailId.description: Email address to which the new voicemail audio will be sent.

emailCopyOfMessage.description: Settings for sending a copy of new voicemail message audio via email.

mwiEnabled.description: When `true` desktop phone will indicate there are new voicemails.

storageType.description:
Designates which type of voicemail message storage is used.
 * `INTERNAL` - For message access via phone or the Calling User Portal.
 * `EXTERNAL` - For sending all messages to the person's email.

externalEmail.description: External email address to which the new voicemail audio will be sent.  A value for this field must be provided in the request if a `storageType` of `EXTERNAL` is given in the request.

enabled.description: When `true` FAX messages for new voicemails will be sent to the designated number.

phoneNumber.description: Designates phone number for the FAX. A value for this field must be provided in the request if faxMessage `enabled` field is given as `true` in the request.
